text_en: So the only thing it's really good at, which indeed is a magic trick, is going from exponential time algorithm, which is integer factorization or elliptic curve discrete log problem, which I want to mention a little later, shout out to the ECDLP problem. The quantum computers can do those in polynomial time, which is remarkable.
